summary: Sandbach United fielded an unchanged side against New Mills at Hind Heath Road, looking to secure back-to-back home wins following their narrow victory over Stafford Town on Saturday. The match was evenly contested in the opening stages, with both sides creating early chances but neither able to break the deadlock in the first quarter-hour. The Bach will be hoping to maintain their winning momentum in what promised to be a tough test on an unusually dry pitch.
